module: Editor undo/redo stack. Each action has a name, a data table and two undo/redo functions that receive this table. Actions are grouped into transactions (a single action forms a one-action transaction); undo/redo operate per transaction. The module returns a constructor with no arguments (calls `init`). Default limit: 1000 levels.
notes: `commitAction` outside a transaction immediately runs redoFunc (unless dontCallRedoNow) and returns the RESULT of redoFunc, not the action as the comment says; inside a transaction it returns the action. It returns nil if the action is identical to the last transaction on the stack (ignoring timestamp), and false if undo or redo is missing.

`table.remove(self.undoStack, 0)` is used to remove the oldest transaction when the stack is full: index 0 is not a valid index of a Lua sequence, so the 1000-level limit does not seem to be actually enforced (inferred from code).
`endTransaction` crashes if no transaction has been started (currentTransaction nil). An empty transaction is not added to the stack.
Any new commit or non-empty endTransaction clears the redo stack.
Optional hooks set by the caller: `self.onUndo(action)`, `self.onRedo(action)`, `self.onCommitAction(action)`. Actions store `userId` (editor.userId) and `timestamp` (os.time()).

C.desc: History object. Fields: maxUndoLevels, undoStack, redoStack, currentTransaction.

init.desc: Initializes empty stacks, maxUndoLevels = 1000, no transaction in progress. Called by the constructor.

undo.desc: Undoes `steps` transactions: calls the undo of each action in reverse order, then moves the transaction to the redo stack. Stops if the stack is empty.

steps.desc: number of transactions to undo, 1 by default

redo.desc: Redoes `steps` transactions: calls the redo of each action in order, then puts them back on the undo stack.

steps.desc: number of transactions to redo, 1 by default

beginTransaction.desc: Starts a group of actions that can be undone at once. The redos are only run at endTransaction.

returns.desc: the created transaction, or false if a transaction is already in progress

cancelTransaction.desc: Abandons the current transaction without running or pushing anything (useful if an action failed).

endTransaction.desc: Ends the transaction: pushes it and runs the redos of all its actions (unless dontCallRedoNow), then clears the redo stack.

dontCallRedoNow.desc: true = do not run the redos now

commitAction.desc: Records an undo/redo action and runs its redo. Inside a transaction, the action is only added to the group.

data.desc: data shared by undoFunc and redoFunc

dontCallRedoNow.desc: true = do not call redoFunc now

returns.desc: see notes: result of redoFunc, action, nil (duplicate) or false

clear.desc: Clears the undo and redo stacks (new document).

updateRedoStackObjectId.desc: In the actions of the redo stack, replaces `data.objectId` and the elements of `data.objectIds` equal to oldObjectId with newObjectId (useful when an object is recreated with a different id).

serialize.desc: Writes `data.history = { undoStack, redoStack }` (references, not a copy).

deserialize.desc: Restores the stacks from `data.history` if it exists and cancels the current transaction.
